    e.equipmentcode,
    e.equipmenttype,
    ls.lifesupportstatus,
    ROUND(CAST(
        CASE 
            WHEN om.operationalstatus = 'Active' THEN 10 * (1 - om.operationhours / om.maintenancecyclehours)
            WHEN om.operationalstatus = 'Standby' THEN 5 * (1 - om.operationhours / om.maintenancecyclehours)
            ELSE 0
        END AS numeric
    , 2) AS ORS,
    ROUND(CAST(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.insulationstatus = 'Good' THEN 0.9 - t.heatlossratekwh / 10
            WHEN t.insulationstatus = 'Fair' THEN 0.6 - t.heatlossratekwh / 10
            WHEN t.insulationstatus = 'Poor' THEN 0.3 - t.heatlossratekwh / 10
            ELSE 0
        END AS numeric
    , 2) AS TIE,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (CASE 
            WHEN om.operationalstatus = 'Active' THEN 10 * (1 - om.operationhours / om.maintenancecyclehours)
            WHEN om.operationalstatus = 'Standby' THEN 5 * (1 - om.operationhours / om.maintenancecyclehours)
            ELSE 0
        END * 0.7 + 
        CASE 
            WHEN t.insulationstatus = 'Good' THEN 0.9 - t.heatlossratekwh / 10
            WHEN t.insulationstatus = 'Fair' THEN 0.6 - t.heatlossratekwh / 10
            WHEN t.insulationstatus = 'Poor' THEN 0.3 - t.heatlossratekwh / 10

    , 4) AS LSSR
FROM equipment e
JOIN lightingandsafety ls ON e.equipmentcode = ls.lighteqref
JOIN operationmaintenance om ON e.equipmentcode = om.opmainteqref
JOIN thermalsolarwindandgrid t ON e.equipmentcode = t.thermaleqref
